extension.summary: tofa media server: user interface, plus a browsable video source
extension.description:
An unofficial client for the tofa media server (tofa.tv), in two parts.
Under Programs, tofa opens a full user interface: Home, Browse, Discover, Search, title detail with cast and episodes, its own player chrome, and Settings.
Under Video add-ons, the same library appears as a browsable source, so it can also be used in widgets, favourites and Kodi's own containers.
Both play through Kodi's native VideoPlayer, negotiating DirectPlay/DirectFile so Dolby Vision, TrueHD/DTS-HD passthrough and refresh-rate matching reach it untouched.
extension.disclaimer: An unofficial tofa client, engineered with the tofa team, who also help support it.
extension.news: - Updating the add-on no longer shows a brief error message while the new version installs. 0.9.26 closed one cause; this closes the other, in the background service. Because the version being replaced is the one running during an update, this fix takes effect from the update after this one. - The Home screen now shows the same rows as the other tofa apps: the default rows a profile is missing (Recently Released Movies and TV Shows on older profiles) appear at the end, as they do on the web and on macOS. - Discover rows on Home and in Settings > Appearance carry the server's own names -- "Trending Shows", "New Series Worth Starting" -- so a row reads the same in the "Add a row" list, in the editor and on Home. - New "Leaving soon" row (server 0.9.35): titles the server's lifecycle rules have flagged, with the date each one leaves. Add it under Settings > Appearance > Home screen. - Suggested for You reads "Popular on Your Server" while the server has too little watch history to personalise it, as in the other apps.
